name: llm-gateway
description: A small, native TypeScript OpenAI gateway for desktop LLM clients

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/server.ts dist/llm-gateway && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/dashboard.ts dist/llm-gateway-ui && npm run build:auth
scripts.build:server: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/server.ts dist/llm-gateway
scripts.build:ui: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/dashboard.ts dist/llm-gateway-ui
